root_cause: Normal ingested snapshots live below the parent repository's Git-ignored data directory, so Semgrep's default Git-ignore behavior selected zero files.
Materialized corpus snapshots below tests/fixtures were also excluded by parent/default Semgrep ignore discovery.
semgrep.old_failure_mode: Semgrep returned a successful zero-result SARIF document after selecting zero targets, and the adapter reported the run as empty.
correction: Pass --no-git-ignore because snapshots are intentionally local and ignored by RepoAuditor.
Pass each snapshot as --project-root so outer-repository ignore policy cannot define target selection.
Request simultaneous JSON output and report zero scanned paths or malformed target metadata as failed.

codecov_public_nodejs_pack.interpretation: Ruleset coverage miss: the public pack does not model this library API input as an untrusted source.

bounded_uat.interpretation: Scanner execution is restored and observable. Low advisory-target recall and the patched Lodash signal are detector coverage/precision limitations, not evidence that Semgrep failed to run.

limitations: Binary presence alone is not execution health; per-run status and target selection must remain visible.
A complete scan does not imply adequate vulnerability-family recall.
The bounded corpus has advisory-derived targets rather than exhaustive labels, so unmatched candidates remain unadjudicated.
